title: 第十七章 斩妖盛会结束第十八章 初见姑祖母
lines: “玉阳宫对这梅元知是真不错了，专门给他找了一头凝练妖丹的大妖，让他来一场大战。”云符成轻声笑道，“应该是希望这梅元知借此一战能有所进步，好增加一分进入元初山的希望。”
“大哥，你说梅元知能进元初山吗？”云符安问道，“若是进了元初山，成了神魔。恐怕会压我们云家一头了。”
整个东宁府，就一个张家老祖是元初山的神魔。
若是再多一个？
“进元初山？你以为这么好进的？”云符成轻声道，“大周王朝二十三州，却只有二十个名额。并且王都、州城等地一些强大神魔的子嗣都是想要进去。一个平民出生的天才，想要进元初山……比那些强大神魔子嗣们，要艰难得多。”
“那孟川呢？”云符安忍不住问道，“孟仙姑可是会倾力帮助孟川。”
“孟仙姑又算什么？”云符成轻轻摇头，真元隐隐笼罩周围隔绝声音，“都没能进入元初山。就是我们的父亲，最大的目标也是想要进入元初山。”
云符安点点头。
能不能进元初山，已经成为划分神魔强弱的一条线。
只要足够强大，都会被元初山主动邀请进入的。
“至于梅元知，悟冰势太晚，进元初山只有两三分希望。”云符成说道，“而且我了解他的脾气，他孤傲的很，就算成了元初山神魔，也不会甘心留在东宁府的。”
这天下间除了有大家族羁绊的。真正没什么牵挂的平民子弟，若是天赋卓绝，更愿意从此扎根在州城、王都，甚至举家搬迁到元初山一带。
各方议论纷纷，谈论着这位梅元知。
很多都觉得梅元知进入元初山希望很低，但大家也清楚，至少梅元知还有希望。这已经很了不起了。
“小心点。”玉阳宫主嘱托一声。
“嗯。”消瘦的梅元知站了起来，朝擂台走去。
走到擂台上，在他对面是一位全身有着黑色甲壳的妖怪，它有着女性化的面孔，六条覆盖着黑甲壳的手臂，同时一条黑色锋利尾巴格外显眼。它似笑非笑看着梅元知，声音却温柔的很：“很年轻的小家伙，我能够感觉到你旺盛的生命力。”
梅元知拔剑出鞘，一股恐怖寒意正在凝结，这一刻的梅元知就仿佛一座万年冰山，威势不断提升。甚至渐渐外放的些许寒气，令擂台地面都开始凝结冰霜。
“冰势？”蜈蚣女妖笑了笑，“不过看起来悟出没多久嘛。”
梅元知眼中寒光一闪。
一瞬间身体分化为七，七道身影出现在不同方位，围绕着蜈蚣女妖，分别劈出了一道剑光。
七道剑光，斩杀向中央的蜈蚣女妖。
“就这么点力量还分散？”蜈蚣女妖站在原地都没动，六条手臂直接朝四面八方接连拍击出，轰轰轰~~~~蜈蚣女妖的手掌白皙，却无比的坚韧，硬碰硬将每一道剑光给拍的粉碎。
梅元知真身却陡然出现在蜈蚣女妖近前，一道剑光直刺向蜈蚣女妖的头颅，这一剑来的诡异，但更快，且比刚才七道剑光更恐怖。
“嗯？”蜈蚣女妖一惊，其中两只手陡然合拢，强行合拢夹住了那一柄利剑。
它盯着梅元知，咧嘴一笑：“原来那七道剑光是故意迷惑，这才是杀招？”
“裂！”梅元知眼中厉芒一闪。
蜈蚣女妖双手握着的利剑陡然炸裂，长剑的碎片有真气裹挟着四射，距离太近，有碎片都射在蜈蚣女妖的脸上，令它发出惨嚎。
梅元知双掌表面凝结冰层，一双手掌直接劈在蜈蚣女妖的胸膛上。
“嘭！！！”蜈蚣女妖直接被轰的倒飞出去。
“这才是杀招！”梅元知眼中冰冷，他很清楚和凝练妖丹的蜈蚣女妖比，他是要弱一筹的。所以一来就是拼尽全力，外界都知晓他擅长剑法。实际上他悟出的是冰势，用剑法施展冰势，和拳法掌法施展冰势并无多大区别，剑对他并不重要，只是迷惑外人罢了。
蜈蚣女妖脸上有着伤口血迹，胸口也凹陷，倒飞的同时就发出愤怒的嚎叫：“果真是阴险的人族，给我受死！！！”
狂怒的蜈蚣女妖气息暴涨，妖丹却直接碎裂开来，一瞬间妖力雄浑到极致。
content_en:
"Yuyang Palace is really nice to Mei Yuanzhi. They specially found him a big demon who has condensed the demon elixir and let him have a battle." Yun Fucheng chuckled, "It should be that they hope that Mei Yuanzhi can make progress through this battle, so as to increase the hope of entering Yuanchu Mountain."
"Brother, do you think Mei Yuanzhi can enter Yuanchu Mountain?" Yun Fu'an asked, "If he enters Yuanchu Mountain and becomes a god or demon, he will probably overwhelm our Yun family."
In the entire Dongning Mansion, there is only one ancestor of the Zhang family who is the god and demon of Yuanchu Mountain.
What if there is one more?
"Enter the Yuanchu Mountain? Do you think it is so easy to enter?" Yun Fucheng said softly, "There are only twenty places in the twenty-three states of the Great Zhou Dynasty. And the descendants of some powerful gods and demons in the royal capital, state cities and other places want to enter. A genius born as a commoner wants to enter the Yuanchu Mountain... It is much more difficult than those descendants of the powerful gods and demons."
"What about Meng Chuan?" Yun Fu'an couldn't help but ask, "Meng Xiangu will do her best to help Meng Chuan."
"Who does Meng Xiangu mean?" Yun Fucheng shook his head gently, his true energy faintly enveloped the surroundings to isolate the sound, "They have not been able to enter the Yuanchu Mountain. Even our father, the biggest goal is to enter the Yuanchu Mountain."
Yun Fu'an nodded.
Whether you can enter Yuanchu Mountain has become a line that divides the strength of gods and demons.
As long as they are strong enough, they will be actively invited to enter by Yuanchu Mountain.
"As for Mei Yuanzhi, it was too late to realize the ice power, and he only has two or three hopes of entering Yuanchu Mountain." Yun Fucheng said, "And I understand his temper. He is very aloof. Even if he becomes the god and demon of Yuanchu Mountain, he will not be willing to stay in Dongning Mansion."
In this world, there are only those who are bound by big families. If the children of common people who really have nothing to worry about are extremely talented, they would rather take root in the prefectural city, the royal capital, or even move their families to the Yuanchu Mountain area.
…
There was a lot of discussion from all sides about this Mei Yuanzhi.
Many people think that Mei Yuanzhi has low hope of entering Yuanchu Mountain, but everyone also knows that at least Mei Yuanzhi still has hope. This is already amazing.
"Be careful." Palace Master Yuyang warned.
"Yeah." The thin Mei Yuanzhi stood up and walked towards the ring.
Walking onto the ring, opposite him was a monster with a black carapace all over its body. It had a feminine face, six arms covered with black carapace, and a sharp black tail that was particularly conspicuous. It looked at Mei Yuanzhi with a faint smile, but its voice was very gentle: "You are very young, I can feel your strong vitality."
Mei Yuanzhi drew his sword out of its scabbard, and a terrifying chill was condensing. At this moment, Mei Yuanzhi was like a ten-thousand-year-old iceberg, and his power continued to increase. Even a little bit of cold air gradually spread out, causing frost to condense on the ground of the arena.
"Ice power?" Centipede Banshee smiled, "But it seems that she realized it not long ago."
"Kill."
Mei Yuanzhi's eyes flashed coldly.
In an instant, the body divided into seven, and seven figures appeared in different directions, surrounding the Centipede Banshee, and each struck out a sword light.
Seven rays of sword light slayed the Centipede Banshee in the center.
"How can you spread out such a small amount of power?" The Centipede Banshee stood on the spot without moving, and struck out with six arms in all directions, boom boom~~~ The centipede banshee's palms were white, but extremely tough, and she smashed every sword light into pieces in a head-on collision.
"Pfft."
Mei Yuanzhi's real body suddenly appeared in front of the Centipede Banshee, and a sword light pierced the Centipede Banshee's head. This sword was strange, but faster, and more terrifying than the seven sword lights just now.
"Huh?" Centipede Banshee was startled. Two of her hands suddenly closed together and clamped the sharp sword.
It stared at Mei Yuanzhi and grinned: "So those seven sword lights were deliberately confusing. Is this the killing move?"
"Crack!" Mei Yuanzhi's eyes flashed sharply.
The sharp sword held by the Centipede Banshee suddenly exploded, and the fragments of the long sword were filled with zhenqi. The distance was too close, and some of the fragments hit the Centipede Banshee's face, causing it to howl miserably.
Ice formed on the surface of Mei Yuanzhi's palms, and he struck directly on the Centipede Banshee's chest.
"Bang!!!" The Centipede Banshee was sent flying backwards.
"This is the killing move!" Mei Yuanzhi's eyes were cold. He knew very well that he was weaker than the Centipede Banshee who had condensed the demon elixir. So he tried his best as soon as he came, and the outside world knew that he was good at swordsmanship. In fact, what he realized was the power of ice. Using swordsmanship to exert ice power is not much different from using fists and palms to exert ice power. The sword is not important to him, it just confuses outsiders.
The Centipede Banshee had blood stains on her face and her chest was dented. As she flew upside down, she let out an angry howl: "You are really an insidious human race, let me die!!!"
The furious Centipede Banshee's aura surged, but the demon pill directly shattered. In an instant, the demonic power was extremely powerful.
"Die!!!"
